title: Hummingbird Cabaret with Kid Clayton and George Gaynor
summary: His first band job was at the Hummingbird Cabaret at Bienville and Marais in the District, with Clayton and George Gaynor; he stayed a year or two.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: So I went through with him, so I went for myself. And some fellas came and hired me to play at the Hummin' Boyd Cabaret. With Kit Clayton's band.
Oh yeah, George Gaynor was about here. He used to go there, that's the first place he ever had.
That's where George Gaynor and Clayton was playing. I was playing with George Gaynor and Clayton at the Hummin' Boyd Cabaret.
I was at Bienville and Murray.

Is the district still running then? The district was still running then. And we played there for years. I played there for about a year, maybe two years. As long as I was running, I went to the entertainers. You heard of the entertainers? Well I still played there a while. So from then on, Sam Morgan had a drummer by the name of Roy Evans. Well, Roy Evans got hit with a brick, appetite on a truck. And it seemed like the drummer that Morgan had, the drummer that was playing with Morgan got hit with a brick. Yeah. That told me, the drummer that played with Chris Kelly went with Morgan.
